{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values and their sample_seq
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

# Show the number of patients with multiple records and their sample_seq
print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Sample sequences for duplicate patients:")
duplicates_with_seq = data[data['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print(duplicates_with_seq[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']])"}
